items.title: Ollama re-raises and logs unrecognised ResponseError
items.criterion: In OllamaAPI._query_string, any ResponseError that matches neither known message is logged to the log file and re-raised, so the coroutine never returns None. A test covers this case.

items.title: Reject empty-list prompts in all API validators and query dispatch
items.criterion: check_prompt_dict and query for openai, azure, anthropic, gemini, vertexai, ollama and huggingface_tgi reject an empty prompt list with TYPE_ERROR, with no IndexError and no empty chat. Regression tests are added.

items.title: HF TGI check_prompt_dict rejects lists containing non-strings
items.criterion: The list branch of HuggingfaceTGIAPI.check_prompt_dict appends TYPE_ERROR when not every element is a str.

items.title: Azure/Ollama query guard dict type before calling keys()
items.criterion: AzureOpenAIAPI.query and OllamaAPI.query check that all elements are dicts before accessing d.keys(), so a mixed list raises TYPE_ERROR rather than AttributeError.

items.title: Remove global openai module mutations in OpenAI/Azure/TGI
items.criterion: _obtain_model_inputs no longer assigns openai.api_key, api_type, azure_endpoint or api_version, which includes TGI setting api_type to a URL. Configuration comes only from the client constructor arguments.

items.title: Azure API version falls back to AZURE_API_VERSION_DEFAULT
items.criterion: When no model-specific or global API version env var exists, _obtain_model_inputs catches the KeyError and uses AZURE_API_VERSION_DEFAULT instead of failing.

items.title: HF TGI API key optional at query time
items.criterion: _obtain_model_inputs no longer requires the TGI API key. A missing key falls back to a placeholder (or omits auth), so unauthenticated endpoints work.

items.title: Accumulate multimedia path errors with update()
items.criterion: is_valid_jsonl uses .update() or |= instead of a discarded .union(), so the missing-multimedia-path summary is reported. A test covers missing files.

items.title: check_multimedia robust to malformed containers and items
items.criterion: check_multimedia returns early when multimedia is not a list, skips non-dict items, and uses m.get('type'), so it never raises TypeError or KeyError.

items.title: is_valid_jsonl skips adapter checks when required keys missing
items.criterion: check_prompt_dict is called only when the line is a dict containing 'prompt' and 'model_name'. Otherwise the issues are recorded without an uncaught KeyError or TypeError.

items.title: Gemini/Vertex blocked chat turn keeps safety_attributes a list
items.criterion: On IndexError in _query_chat, the blocked-turn attributes are appended to safety_attributes_list and that list is stored, matching the length of response. A stale previous response is never used.

items.title: Replace bare except and unassigned response in Gemini/Vertex handlers
items.criterion: The IndexError handlers initialise response=None before the try and use `except Exception` (or an explicit helper) instead of a bare except.

items.title: Logging helpers safe for None/list responses and structured prompts
items.criterion: log_success/error_response helpers convert prompt and response_text with str() or a bounded formatter before truncating. A None or list response then neither raises nor dumps huge structures.

items.title: Reject zero and boolean rate limits and settings
items.criterion: check_max_queries_dict rejects values <= 0 and bools at both top level and nested level. Settings max_queries and max_attempts also reject bools.

items.title: Experiment.process handles empty input files
items.criterion: An experiment with zero queries raises a clear error at construction, or completes with a zero average, without ZeroDivisionError or FileNotFoundError. A test is included.

items.title: Rephrasal module with Rephraser class
items.criterion: A new prompto.rephrasal module provides a Rephraser that validates rephrase settings (api/model_name/parameters). It builds rephrase prompts from templates × models × inputs with ids like rephrase-{model}-{i}-{id}, writes them to a .jsonl file, and loads a rephrase folder.

items.title: run_experiment supports a rephrase pre-processing step
items.criterion: prompto_run_experiment accepts --rephrase-folder, --rephrase-templates and --rephrase-model. It runs a rephrase experiment first, creates a post-rephrase input file and then processes that file.

items.title: --only-rephrase flag stops before processing
items.criterion: With --only-rephrase, main() returns right after writing the rephrased input file, so the original experiment is neither moved nor processed.

items.title: Option to drop original prompts from rephrased file
items.criterion: A --remove-original flag is passed as keep_original=False to create_new_input_file, so only rephrased prompts are kept.

items.title: Rephrase response parser option
items.criterion: A --rephrase-parser option selects a function from rephrasal_parser.PARSER_FUNCTIONS to split responses into multiple prompts. When the option is not given, parser=None is passed without an error.

items.title: split_numbered_list only splits on line-leading numbers
items.criterion: The regex matches digits followed by '.' only at the start of the text or after a newline. Parts are stripped before the leading empty part is removed.

items.title: Rephrased input uses response text and 'NA' default id
items.criterion: _convert_rephrased_prompt_dict_to_input sets prompt from the rephrase 'response' (not the template prompt), restores the input-api/model/parameters, and defaults input-id to 'NA'.

items.title: Rename judge --templates to --judge-templates
items.criterion: The CLI argument is --judge-templates in create_judge_file and run_experiment, and the docs and notebooks are updated to match.

items.title: Moved CSV input keeps .csv extension in output folder
items.criterion: When the original experiment file is a .csv, run_experiment moves it to output as name.csv rather than name.jsonl.

items.title: Tests for Rephraser and run_experiment rephrase/judge flows
items.criterion: Adds tests/core/test_rephrasal.py and tests/scripts/test_run_experiment_command.py covering rephrase settings validation, file creation, conversion, and CLI runs with rephrase, judge and CSV input.

items.title: Fix load_judge_args docstring and return annotation
items.criterion: load_judge_args documents judge_templates_arg, and its return annotation reflects a dict of template prompts instead of str. load_rephrase_args gains a typed docstring.

items.title: Rephrasals documentation page
items.criterion: Adds docs/rephrasals.md, links it from docs/README.md and mkdocs.yml, and documents the rephrase command in commands.md. Includes an example notebook.

items.title: Gemini supports uploaded media files
items.criterion: Gemini prompts can reference media uploaded via the File API (e.g. an uploaded_filename for video/images). Async upload and delete helpers are added with tests.

items.title: Consistent 'data folder' vs 'media folder' terminology
items.criterion: Code and docs consistently use 'media folder' for multimedia files and 'data folder' for experiment data.

items.title: CD workflow uses artifact actions v4
items.criterion: cd.yaml uses actions/upload-artifact@v4 and download-artifact@v4, with a matching artifact name.

items.title: Resolve conflicting PyPI auth in CD publish job
items.criterion: The publish job uses either OIDC trusted publishing without a password, or a token without the id-token permission, but not both.

items.title: Update Google and other dependencies
items.criterion: pyproject.toml dependency pins are updated, including the Google genai/vertex packages.

items.title: OpenAI local image data URL uses real MIME type
items.criterion: parse_content_value derives the MIME type (e.g. mimetypes.guess_type) for local images instead of always using image/jpeg.

items.title: OpenAI image_url accepts http/data URLs and validates objects
items.criterion: http:// and data: URLs are treated as remote rather than local paths. A non-string image_url that is not a mapping raises a clear error.

items.title: Vertex local video honours mime_type and closes file
items.criterion: parse_parts_value passes the user's mime_type to Part.from_data for local videos and reads the file inside a with block.

items.title: Quart endpoint check uses timeout and catches errors
items.criterion: QuartAPI.check_environment_variables calls requests.get with a timeout and records a ValueError issue on exception instead of crashing or hanging.

items.title: Quart server applies per-request options and validates input
items.criterion: quart_api.generate passes data['options'] to pipe() merged with max_length, and returns 400 for missing or non-string text.

items.title: TestAPI handles boolean raise_error parameter
items.criterion: TestAPI.query handles a bool raise_error without calling .lower() on it, and non-dict parameters are handled cleanly.

items.title: Settings max_queries_dict default not mutable
items.criterion: Settings.__init__ defaults max_queries_dict to None and creates a fresh dict (or copy) per instance.

items.title: ExperimentPipeline sleeps when idle
items.criterion: ExperimentPipeline.run sleeps for a configurable poll interval when no files are present, and a test mocks the sleep.

items.title: move_file works across filesystems
items.criterion: utils.move_file uses shutil.move instead of os.rename.

items.title: Judge template keys use full stem
items.criterion: load_judge_folder derives keys with os.path.splitext/Path.stem instead of split('.')[0], and errors on duplicate names.

items.title: obtain_missing_id_jsonl uses set lookup and single write-mode open
items.criterion: Output ids are stored in a set, the new file is opened once in 'w' mode outside the loop, and file handles used for line counts are closed.

items.title: get_ids catches specific parsing errors
items.criterion: The bare except in get_ids is replaced with JSONDecodeError/KeyError handling that reports the line.

items.title: CSV inputs produce valid JSON-serialisable values
items.criterion: Rows read from CSV have numpy scalars converted to native types and NaN replaced or dropped, so json.dump yields valid JSON. Parameter columns are matched with startswith('parameters-').

items.title: Judge templates with literal braces don't crash
items.criterion: create_judge_inputs substitutes {INPUT_PROMPT}/{OUTPUT_RESPONSE} without str.format failing on other braces. A test with a JSON example template is added.

items.title: Judge validates completed responses have prompt/response
items.criterion: Judge validates that completed_responses is a list of dicts containing 'prompt' and 'response', and raises a clear error otherwise.

items.title: Scorers handle list/None responses and missing expected_response
items.criterion: match/includes handle None and list (chat) responses explicitly, and raise a descriptive error when expected_response is absent.

items.title: Anthropic process_response filters to text blocks
items.criterion: process_response extracts text only from blocks of type 'text', with no AttributeError on tool_use blocks. A mocked test is added.

items.title: Anthropic TYPE_ERROR and docstrings say 'assistant'/'content'
items.criterion: Anthropic TYPE_ERROR lists 'user'/'assistant'. The convert_dict_to_input and parse_content_value docstrings match the actual keys, and the test TYPE_ERROR_MSG is updated.

items.title: Correct _obtain_model_inputs return annotations/docstrings
items.criterion: Gemini/Vertex annotations reflect the 5-tuple actually returned. OpenAI/TGI docstrings no longer mention AsyncAzureOpenAI, and the Vertex env var docstring says VERTEXAI_LOCATION_ID.

items.title: parse_list_arg drops empty items
items.criterion: Empty and whitespace items (e.g. 'a,,b', trailing comma, '') are filtered out, and a test is added.

items.title: Share env/max-queries loaders across CLI scripts
items.criterion: run_pipeline and check_experiment import load_env_file/load_max_queries_json rather than reimplementing them.

items.title: convert_images requires --folder
items.criterion: --folder is required (and validated as a directory), so the script never defaults to rewriting the cwd.

items.title: Docs reference generation scans only package source
items.criterion: gen_ref_pages.py uses CODE_PATH under src, so module names start with 'prompto' and .venv and other non-package files are excluded.

items.title: HF TGI default mode and comment consistent
items.criterion: The default mode in _obtain_model_inputs matches its comment and docs. Upstream made it 'chat'.

items.title: Gemini parse_parts_value doesn't shadow builtin type
items.criterion: The local `type` variable is renamed (e.g. media_type) in the gemini, vertex, openai and anthropic utils, so `type(err).__name__` in error handling works. A test patches get_file to raise.

items.title: Gemini/Vertex history requires a non-system message
items.criterion: A history consisting only of a system message is rejected by check_prompt_dict and query.

items.title: Gemini/Vertex history must end with user turn
items.criterion: Validation rejects histories whose final message is not role 'user'.

items.title: HF TGI sends prompt's model_name
items.criterion: TGI chat and completion calls pass model=model_name instead of self.api_type.

items.title: check_experiment exits non-zero on invalid file
items.criterion: main() calls sys.exit(1) when the experiment file is invalid, and the dead log_file None check is removed.

items.title: CSV integer parameters not upcast to float
items.criterion: Integer-valued parameters from CSV columns that contain NaN are passed as ints (e.g. via convert_dtypes or whole-number conversion).

items.title: CSV/JSONL path rewriting changes only the suffix
items.criterion: process() uses removesuffix/splitext rather than str.replace to switch between .csv and .jsonl.

items.title: Validate JSONL lines are non-empty JSON objects
items.criterion: _read_input_file raises a ValueError with a line number for blank lines or non-object JSON values.

items.title: Validate parameters is a dict in check_prompt_dict
items.criterion: OpenAI, Azure, Anthropic, Ollama, TGI and Quart check_prompt_dict report an issue when parameters is present but not a dict or None.

items.title: run_experiment doesn't silently run stale same-named input
items.criterion: If a file with the same basename but a different real path exists in the input folder, it is overwritten or an error is raised, rather than the stale file being used.

items.title: Pipeline survives bad experiment files
items.criterion: ExperimentPipeline.run catches exceptions from Experiment construction or processing for one file, logs them, and continues.

items.title: Pipeline average time weighted by query count
items.criterion: The pipeline's average per-query time is computed from total time divided by total queries, not as a mean of per-experiment averages.

items.title: First request not delayed by rate-limit interval
items.criterion: send_requests launches the first task immediately and sleeps only between subsequent launches.

items.title: group_prompts avoids creating empty groups
items.criterion: Group buckets are created only after the model-specific key is resolved, so no empty group is created or processed.

items.title: Settings validates parallel as bool
items.criterion: Settings raises TypeError when parallel is not a bool.

items.title: Settings max_queries_dict validated on assignment
items.criterion: max_queries_dict becomes a property whose setter calls check_max_queries_dict. The max_queries and max_attempts setters raise TypeError for non-ints, consistent with __init__.

items.title: Gemini process_response joins all text parts
items.criterion: process_response concatenates all text parts of the first candidate and defines the behaviour when no text is present.

items.title: Anthropic omits system when empty
items.criterion: _query_history passes NOT_GIVEN, or omits system, when no system message exists, instead of an empty string.

items.title: Quart client uses timeout and reports response body
items.criterion: async_client_generate sets an aiohttp ClientTimeout, sends json=, and includes a bounded response body in error messages.

items.title: Quart uses get_environment_variable helper
items.criterion: QuartAPI._obtain_model_inputs resolves the endpoint via get_environment_variable, like the other APIs.

items.title: Deduplicate encode_image and safety threshold mapping
items.criterion: A single shared encode_image is used by both modules, and a shared safety-filter→HarmBlockThreshold mapping is used by Gemini and Vertex, including in check_prompt_dict.

items.title: Judge creates output directory before writing
items.criterion: create_judge_file creates the parent directory, or raises a clear validation error, before opening the output file.

items.title: Don't mask internal ImportErrors as missing optional deps
items.criterion: prompto.apis suppresses only ImportErrors for the known optional packages, e.g. by checking find_spec or err.name.

items.title: convert_images preserves PNG transparency
items.criterion: PNG images keep their alpha channel (RGBA) or are written to a separate folder rather than flattened in place.

items.title: Unit tests for OpenAI/Azure/Ollama/TGI/Quart adapters
items.criterion: Tests are added under tests/apis that cover check_environment_variables, check_prompt_dict, _obtain_model_inputs and query for these adapters.

items.title: Tests for check_experiment and obtain_missing_id_jsonl
items.criterion: Adds tests/scripts/test_check_experiment.py and test_obtain_missing_id_jsonl.py covering the validation paths.

items.title: Fix undefined cache key in ci.yaml
items.criterion: The actions/cache key in ci.yaml no longer references the undefined env.cache_id.

items.title: Fix invalid annotations in system-demo api_utils
items.criterion: dict[int] becomes dict[str, Any], and except (Exception, BaseException) becomes except Exception.

items.title: Use typing.Callable in experiment annotations
items.criterion: evaluation_funcs annotations use list[Callable] instead of list[callable].

items.title: Fix broken example links in multimodal notebooks
items.criterion: The anthropic, azure and openai multimodal notebooks point to existing example jsonl files (e.g. azure-openai-multimodal-example.jsonl) and drop stale links.
